info.name: Service 8 - Notification and Alert Management (Elias Ghanem)
info.description: Postman requests for the six Notification and Alert Management APIs, implemented by Elias Ghanem. Run the users (5001) and notifications (5008) services, fill in the username/password collection variables for one active account per role (ADMIN, ANALYST, AUDITOR, EMPLOYEE), then run the folders in order. The setup folder logs in each role; tokens, user IDs and notification IDs are saved automatically in collection variables. Run it on a database where these four users have no other notifications so the count checks hold.

request.description: Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in adminToken and the account ID in adminUserId.
Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in analystToken and the account ID in analystUserId.
Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in auditorToken and the account ID in auditorUserId.
Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in employeeToken and the account ID in employeeUserId.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Create Threat Alert for Analyst

request.description: High-severity threat alert for the analyst. Used by the search examples.

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": {{analystUserId}},
  "title": "New ransomware indicators",
  "message": "Threat intelligence reports new LockBit indicators targeting our sector.",
  "notification_type": "Threat Alert",
  "severity": "High"
}

request.description: notification_type must be one of the five supported types.
severity must be Low, Medium, High or Critical.
user_id, title, message, notification_type and severity are all required.
status and read_at are set by the server and cannot be supplied.
user_id must reference an existing active user.
